name: SGLT2 inhibitors in heart failure
description: Randomised trials of SGLT2 inhibitors in adults with heart failure. Decoys include diabetes-only and animal studies.

records.title: Empagliflozin in a rodent model of heart failure: mechanistic findings (Zurich 2)
records.abstract: We studied Empagliflozin in a rat model of myocardial infarction. Forty animals received Empagliflozin or vehicle for 14 days and tissue markers were measured.

records.title: Canagliflozin in adults with heart failure: a randomised controlled trial (Pune cohort 18)
records.abstract: Background: Evidence for Canagliflozin in heart failure is limited. Methods: In this double-blind trial, 91 adults (aged 18-80) with heart failure were randomised to Canagliflozin or placebo for 8 weeks. The primary outcome was NT-proBNP. Results: A modest improvement in NT-proBNP was observed (p = 0.47). Conclusion: Results support further study.
